integrity.statement: These are explicit migration constraints for evidence-constrained decomposition. They do not encode a Faculty->faculty-service mapping. Algorithms must reason from evidence plus these rules.

rules.statement: Decompose the legacy system into independently deployable services.
Prefer database ownership by one service.
Prefer boundaries aligned with business capabilities.
Identify cases in which strict isolation would create excessive communication.
Explicitly report uncertain architectural decisions instead of silently guessing.
